name: Jazz Waltz Saloon (Ab, 3/4)
desc: 3/4 jazz waltz in Ab major at cps 0.42: Elvin-style triplet ride waltz kit, three-to-the-bar walking bass, breathy saxello floating long ballad phrases across the barlines and the Db-lydian glow pad (Ab collection) holding the room - late-set waltz at the piano-less saloon.
